messages.subject: search_eurostat by code
parts:
Dear all,
I'd like to check last version available from  "last update of data"  for a certain number of indicators from which I already know their code. The search_eurostat() would do, but I cannot search by "code".

Alternatively, I thought I could use the title, but I cannot get the right result if I use the complete title. For instance, for the indicator titled ""Live births (total) by NUTS 3 region" if I use the following sentence:  
LiveBirths <- search_eurostat("Live births (total) by NUTS 3 region")

the result is an object with 0 observations of 8 variables. Though if I modify the sentence to a more general:

LiveBirths2 <- search_eurostat("Live births")

Then the result is a new object with 20 observations of 8 variables.

 titlecodetypelast update of datalast table structure changedata startdata endvalues
1Live births (total) by NUTS 3 regiondemo_r_birthsdataset23.09.201606.10.201619902014NA
2Live births by five year age group of the mothers and NUTS 3 regiondemo_r_fagec3dataset23.09.201626.02.201620132014NA
3Live births by mother's age and NUTS 2 regiondemo_r_fagecdataset20.09.201606.10.201619902014NA
4Live births (total) by metropolitan regionsmet_birthsdataset11.10.201611.10.201619902014NA
5Live births (total) by coastal regionsmare_birthsdataset11.10.2016NA19902014NA
6Live births (total) by urban-rural typologyurt_birthsdataset11.10.2016NA19902014NA

Why I can't query using the title from the first object? Do you have any clue on what is going on? Alternatively, do you know how I cna query by code??

Many thanks in advance,
Raquel Ubach

messages.author: ceb6545892b4dd19
messages.subject: Re: search_eurostat by code
parts:
Hi Raquel,

Doing the following should get you what you want:

LiveBirths <- search_eurostat("Live births \\(total\\) by NUTS 3 region")

The pattern argument provided to search_eurostat() function is in fact a regular expression in which you will have to escape ("\\") the parentheses if you want them to be taken literally. The documentation could be improved on this.

Hope this helps,

Joona
